gc-stack-heap-q11: Vec representation versus physical stack placement and allocation optimization.
gc-manual-memory-q1: Allocation failure must also be handled.
gc-manual-memory-q2: Null dereference is UB, not guaranteed clean crash.
gc-manual-memory-q3: Bound leak rate units and remove guaranteed OOM timeline.

gc-manual-memory-q5: Reachable retention is only a leak when no longer useful.
gc-manual-memory-q7: Destructors require unwinding; termination not universally covered.
gc-manual-memory-q9: Memory-safe languages include runtime enforcement, not all static.

gc-refcounting-q3: Tree ownership choice assumes no external strong child owners.

gc-refcounting-q5: Strong count traffic not literally every pointer copy or read.

gc-refcounting-q8: Arc requires Send/Sync payload traits.

gc-refcounting-q11: Cycle-free ownership restrictions are another valid design; delayed RC release caveat.

gc-tracing-q3: Compaction memory depends on fragmentation/metadata; no universal comparison.
gc-tracing-q4: Object count approximates cost only under size/pointer assumptions.
gc-tracing-q5: Root visitation order must be specified.

gc-tracing-q8: Precision does not imply moving heap; hybrid conservative designs exist.
gc-tracing-q9: Cost ratio is an explicit steady-state approximation.
gc-tracing-q10: Card arithmetic illustrative not exact all-HotSpot universal behavior.
gc-modern-q2: Black means own fields scanned, not descendants fully scanned.
gc-modern-q8: Median alone cannot determine p99; distinguish arriving during pause from in-flight overlap.
gc-modern-q10: Reference-load checks can be optimized; self-healing repeated across phases.
gc-modern-q11: No universal ranking of pause lengths by collector.
gc-rust-ownership-q2: Copy is semantic trait not stack placement.
gc-rust-ownership-q3: Shared borrowing allows controlled interior mutability.
gc-rust-ownership-q5: Reallocation may grow in place and does not universally mean new address.
gc-rust-ownership-q7: Soundness assumes correct unsafe abstractions/compiler.
gc-rust-ownership-q8: Box clones payload via Clone, not necessarily recursively deep.
gc-rust-ownership-q9: Wildcard temporary differs existing place; current lock lint denies problematic statement.
gc-rust-ownership-q10: Rust can reinitialize after move; C++ std::move alone does not perform move.
gc-rust-ownership-q11: Arena references require stable storage; weak edges must break every strong cycle.
